rules.likely_w01_miss: At least two independent identifier families, year difference <=1 or missing, and normalised-title similarity >=0.65.
rules.metadata_or_identifier_conflict: At least two independent identifier families plus either year difference >=3 or normalised-title similarity <0.35.
rules.ambiguous_manual: High-evidence disagreement not meeting either conservative rule.

caution: These are triage labels, not duplicate decisions. Low title similarity includes translations, chapter/book-title variants and source corruption, so the conflict bucket requires external metadata validation.
